column2: the plan adds bounded warnings for cli subprocess failures at the `read-version` and `upsert-summary` sites (lines 733–755) and at the diagram launch path. those warnings must not use bare `print()` on default stdout. `post_tracking_issue_main` and `generate_code_flow_diagram_main` emit machine-parseable `key=value` lines via `_emit_kv` on stdout, and `bootstrap._parse_kv` reads `tracking post-issue` stdout. warnings interleaved on stdout can be parsed as spurious kv rows when the text contains `=`.

a new regression test that only asserts the launch argv but leaves `subprocess.run` live will be flaky or may never reach the launch assertion. `generate_code_flow_diagram` calls `git merge-base`, optional `git rev-parse`, `git diff`, then the cli launch. without `larch_test_launch_claude_subprocess` and without stubbing the git calls, the test depends on real git state and may fail before argv is inspected.
